priceSnapshot.note: The overnight advance stalled and gave a little back. Spot is 64,967.0, which is 39.0 points BELOW the 65,006.0 the midnight session stamped at 02:07 COT, -0.06% over four hours and fifty minutes. The shape of those hours matters more than the net change. Price pushed to 65,053.1 in the 09:30Z fifteen-minute bar - the session high, and 66.9 points short of the 65,120 add trigger the midnight session published - then rolled over through the 11:00Z hour and has spent the last forty-five minutes between 64,956.7 and 65,015.0. The session low since the midnight ledger snapshot is 64,941.4 in the 08:00Z bar. So the whole morning has been a 111.7-point box, 0.17% wide, sitting on top of the overnight range rather than extending it. Volume tells the same story: the 07:00Z hour turned over 108.56 BTC as European desks opened, and every hour since has been lighter - 46.62, 30.08, 33.27 and 23.50 BTC in the in-progress 11:00Z bar. This is a Saturday tape thinning out, not a market being distributed into.

reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE below $64,650 - held UNCHANGED for a FIFTH consecutive session. Nothing has happened this morning that argues for moving it. The lowest 1H close since the midnight stamp is 64,956.9 (07:00Z) and the lowest trade is 64,941.4, so the line has 291.4 points of clearance, 0.45%, well inside a 2.23% daily ATR. What sits at the line has firmed slightly: the 1H EMA50 has risen from 64,721.42 to 64,760.64 and the daily EMA50 is unchanged at 64,696.29, so a 1H close under 64,650 would be a close beneath BOTH of them plus the 4H EMA20 at 64,575.82 only 75 points lower. Below the line the CoinGlass heatmap read live this morning shows 1.11M of leveraged exposure at 64,515.85 and 1.23M at 64,446.74 - a 2.34M pocket that would pull hard once 64,650 broke.

addIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE above $65,120 - HELD UNCHANGED from the midnight session, and deliberately so. The level was tested and missed by 66.9 points: the session high of 65,053.1 came in the 09:30Z bar and no hourly close got past 65,012.2. That is a near miss rather than a rejection, and moving the trigger down to meet the tape would be exactly the mistake the endday session made in the other direction. The case for 65,120 is unchanged and has actually improved: above it the heatmap now shows only 206.71K at 65,276.06 before a 1.03M band at 65,414.28 and the 1.55M peak at 65,483.39, so an hourly close through 65,120 puts price into thin air with 2.58M of fuel stacked 0.69% to 0.79% overhead.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD and both triggers stay where the midnight session put them; what changed is the SIZE of the conviction behind the add, not its direction. Three things moved against the bull case in five hours and one moved for it. Against: the 15m chart lost its EMA20 for the first time since the overnight push, with price at 64,967.0 now under the 64,993.32 EMA20 and 3.5 points under the 64,970.46 EMA50; the 1H MACD histogram went from -2.09 to -8.58, so the deceleration is widening rather than resolving; and the liquidity map, which the midnight session correctly described as clearly pulling up, has flattened to near-symmetry - 2.58M above within 0.79% against 2.34M below within 0.80%. For: the 4H is unambiguously stronger, with the MACD histogram at +19.16 and price above all four EMAs, and the 65,483.39 magnet did NOT discharge, reading 1.55M against a 1.68M scale maximum. Net: same direction, smaller size. This morning buys 12 USDT of spot rather than the larger tranche the midnight session deployed.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull is still up but the asymmetry has narrowed sharply and honesty requires saying so. At midnight the read was 1.58M above against 1.09M below and the direction was not close. This morning it is 2.58M above within 0.79% (1.03M at 65,414.28 plus 1.55M at 65,483.39) against 2.34M below within 0.80% (1.11M at 64,515.85 plus 1.23M at 64,446.74), and the two clusters sit at almost identical distances - 0.69% above and 0.69% below for the nearest of each. A 10% edge in mass is a tilt, not a thesis. What still favours the upside is the SHAPE rather than the size: the path up is thin, with only 206.71K at 65,276.06 and a literal zero at 64,861.4 meaning the first move in either direction meets no resistance, but the upside pocket begins 0.10% closer to a tradeable trigger. The OKX realized-fill cross-check supports the same reading from the other side: of the 30 most recent fills sampled, 27 carry side=buy, which on OKX means SHORT positions being bought back. Shorts have been the ones getting hurt on this grind, and they are the fuel sitting at 65,414-65,483.

calibration.rollingRecord: 55 rows on file before this one. The midnight session called range with a bullish tilt at 40/42/18 from 65,006.0, set position to ADD, held reduce at 64,650 and stepped the add trigger DOWN to a 1H close above 65,120 after two sessions of placing it out of reach. Price is 64,967.0. Neither trigger fired, but the two came far closer to being live than in any recent session: the session high of 65,053.1 missed the add by 66.9 points, against the 326.5-point miss the endday session recorded. The step-down was the right call even though it did not pay - the trigger is now inside the range the tape can actually reach, which is the whole point of calibrating it.
calibration.note: Scored honestly, the midnight ADD has not helped yet, so acting_helped is FALSE. The session deployed cash into spot at a 65,006.0 mark and price is 64,967.0, so the tranche is 39.0 points underwater, -0.06%, roughly two cents of equity on a 201-USDT book. That is noise, and calling it a failure would be as wrong as calling it a success - but the rule is outcome-scored at the next stamp, and the outcome is marginally negative. The process behind it holds up: the add was justified on a four-timeframe EMA reclaim and a 1.58M magnet 0.73% overhead, and the magnet is still there at 1.55M having never been reached. The genuine lesson is about the liquidity map rather than the entry: a magnet that is 0.73% away on a Saturday is roughly a third of a daily ATR, and a third of an ATR is a full session's work in a thinning tape. The midnight session treated proximity as imminence. This one does not.
